items.problem: An App.xaml-level Style with BasedOn={StaticResource TitleTextBlockStyle} (copied from a UWP sample's SharedContent/xaml/Styles.xaml) crashes the app at startup with a XamlParseException; the crash was hard to attribute because the startup-crash table did not name this cause.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 7694 ('startup crash in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll'), 7931 ('The BasedOn={StaticResource TitleTextBlockStyle} can fail in App.xaml if those built-in WinUI 3 styles aren't resolved at Application level'), 7959 ('App launched but exited within 10s - startup crash'). Fixed by inlining setters and dropping BasedOn.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#startup-crashes — 'Known native codes' table, row 0xE0434352 (Managed CLR exception).
items.proposed_improvement: Extend the existing 0xE0434352 row to name XamlParseException from an unresolvable App.xaml resource — specifically a Style BasedOn={StaticResource <system text style>} carried over from UWP SharedContent/Styles.xaml — and give the fix (inline the setters / move into a ResourceDictionary that merges the theme dictionaries).
items.generalizes: UWP SDK samples almost universally ship SharedContent/xaml/Styles.xaml with BasedOn on system text styles; migrating those into App.xaml resources produces this exact startup XamlParseException across many scenarios.
